title: Usage Pattern Share of a Post-Cap Contents Month — Home Oxygen Therapy
content:
# Usage Pattern Share of a Contents Month — Home Oxygen Therapy

The contents amount of a Home Oxygen Therapy contents month paid in full by the coverage is multiplied by the share of the day the order uses oxygen.

| Usage pattern on the order | At least one cylinder refill on record | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| sleep only | either | 60 |
| exertion only | yes | 50 |
| exertion only | no | 100 |
| exertion and sleep | yes | 80 |
| exertion and sleep | no | 100 |
| any other pattern | either | 100 |

**Clause.** The contents amount is multiplied by 60 percent for an order for sleep only, by 50 percent for an order for exertion only with at least one cylinder refill on record, by 80 percent for an order for exertion and sleep with at least one cylinder refill on record, and by 100 percent for any other order. The usage pattern is the one on the oxygen record's order; the cylinder refills are those in the patient's oxygen service history. The multiplication acts on the amount as it stands, without rounding.

## Worked figures (hypothetical contents amount of 80.00)

- Sleep only: 80.00 multiplied by 60 percent is 48.00.
- Exertion only, refills on record: 80.00 multiplied by 50 percent is 40.00.
- Exertion and sleep, refills on record: 80.00 multiplied by 80 percent is 64.00.
- Exertion and sleep, no cylinder refill on record: 80.00.
